verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official CLI. `greptile review` reviews the feature-branch diff in about 60 seconds, and `greptile review --agent` emits raw-text findings with suggested fixes for a coding agent to apply. `greptile onboard` handles terminal setup, an API key covers CI and self-hosted use, and a probe confirms the dedicated CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI.
